name: Ar
overview: The biblical city of Ar, located on the border of Moab, is highlighted in Numbers 21 as a site of divine judgment and destruction. The passage describes how a consuming fire from the city of Sihon, king of the Amorites, brought ruin upon Ar and the surrounding high places of Arnon. This event underscores God's sovereignty in the defeat of Moab’s enemies and the captivity of its people, illustrating His control over the nations and His justice in punishing those who oppose His purposes.
